summary: Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac in this always sought after modern development to the south of the city, well connected and with excellent local amenities, a well presented, deceptively spacious and flexible detached bungalow, with 3 reception rooms, 3 bedrooms and mature gardens to rear.
description:
An excellent opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented detached bungalow of a highly sought-after design by respected local developer Story Homes, offered to the market with no onward chain and tucked away within a quiet cul-de-sac in the desirable Parkland Village development on the southern outskirts of Carlisle.

Set on a generous plot, the property benefits from a block-paved driveway providing ample off-street parking and access to an integral garage. Internally, the accommodation is well maintained throughout, comprising a welcoming reception hallway, a bright front-facing living room opening into the dining area, and a conservatory overlooking the garden—creating a versatile and sociable living space.

The modern kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en-suite shower room, alongside a well-appointed four-piece bathroom.

To the rear, the property enjoys mature, private gardens that are both attractive and easy to maintain.

Further benefits include solar panels to the front and rear elevations, contributing to an EPC rating of Band C.

Conveniently located, with regular bus links to Carlisle city centre, this is a home that combines comfort, efficiency, and accessibility. Early viewing is highly recommended.

Directions From Carlisle city centre, head south on London Road. Continue past London Road Retail Park & Eastern Way on the left-hand side turning right onto Cumwhinton Road. At the mini roundabout take the first exit and and follow this to reach Cherry Lane on the right hand side.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Solar panels.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.
